title: Canadian Commuter E-Bike Comparison
subtitle: Five commuter e-bikes you can buy in Canada for CAD $1,899-$2,699, with specs taken from each maker's own product page.
currency_note: Every price below was read from the maker's Canadian storefront in Canadian dollars (CAD). Specs were read from the maker's own product/spec pages on the date above.

products.best_for: A long, bike-feeling commute: the torque sensor and 100 Nm motor make pedalling feel assisted rather than motorised. It is the heaviest bike here, so it suits a garage or ground-floor lock-up.
products.source_note: Technical Specifications block on the product page (Samsung 50GB / LG M50LT cells, UL 2271). Price from the product's Shopify .js endpoint, CAD.

products.best_for: Short trips and stairs: Rad's lightest bike at 55 lb, with a rear rack rated 55 lb. The small 360 Wh battery is the trade-off - it is the shortest-range bike in this set.
